name: Volumetric Smoke Rendering with Worley Noise and Light Maps
definition: A real-time volumetric rendering technique for smoke using Unity Compute Shaders for texture generation and a vertex/fragment shader for raymarching. It combines Worley noise for density, a light map for scattering, and optional density masks.
summary: A real-time Unity technique using 3D Worley noise and precomputed light maps for efficient GPU smoke rendering with dynamic scattering.
